name: Kazano Tarou
source:
Hanyuuda Trade High School 1st Year.
Star Sign: Sagittarius
Because of his no good parents and his little sister who has an incurable disease, he supports the family by writing affiliate blogs and web development.
He's a kid who loves riches and believes in the survival of the fittest.
He doesn't believe in things like "affection" and "love" or other things without a shape and he considers himself to be a "Realist who is aware of how the world works".
